Rotate all API keys, cloud credentials, and SSH keys accessible to hosts that ran 1.107.0.

references.note: OpenSSF MAL-2026-2144 compromised litellm==1.107.0 release.

SIG-2026-0075.summary: Identifies backdoored litellm==1.107.0 PyPI releases and matching Docker tags distributed during the October 21, 2026 CI/CD pipeline supply-chain compromise.
SIG-2026-0075.title: LiteLLM 1.107.0 Compromised PyPI Package & Container Image (MAL-2026-2144)

mitigation_steps: Upgrade litellm to >= 1.83.7 to sandbox prompt template rendering.
Restrict /prompts/test access to authenticated administrators or disable in production.

references.note: LiteLLM /prompts/test SSTI endpoint advisory.

SIG-2026-0076.summary: Detects requests targeting LiteLLM /prompts/test endpoint with server-side template injection expressions capable of reading environment secrets or executing host code.
SIG-2026-0076.title: LiteLLM /prompts/test Unsandboxed SSTI Remote Code Execution (CVE-2026-42203)

mitigation_steps: Strip or reject external requests containing the isCliRequest HTTP header at the reverse proxy.
Update One API / New API deployments to patched releases and rotate upstream LLM keys.

references.note: Observed isCliRequest header auth-bypass exploitation in LLMjacking campaigns.

SIG-2026-0077.summary: Detects HTTP requests injecting the isCliRequest header against One API or New API gateway management and model endpoints to bypass auth and harvest upstream LLM keys.
SIG-2026-0077.title: One API / New API Family isCliRequest Header Authentication Bypass

mitigation_steps: Patch RAGFlow past CVE-2026-28797 and enable Jinja2 SandboxedEnvironment.
Block HTTP payloads containing Python dunder SSTI introspection primitives on LLM endpoints.

references.note: Active exploitation of RAGFlow CVE-2026-28797 by autonomous agents.

SIG-2026-0078.summary: Detects authenticated Jinja2 template-injection payloads targeting RAGFlow chat completion APIs actively exploited by autonomous agentic key-harvesting campaigns.
SIG-2026-0078.title: RAGFlow Jinja2 Server-Side Template Injection RCE (CVE-2026-28797)

mitigation_steps: Upgrade open-webui to >= 0.10.0 and isolate WebSocket /ws/socket.io/ behind authenticated proxies.
Disable untrusted Jupyter code execution integrations and audit active Socket.IO sessions.

references.note: CISA bulletin reference for Open WebUI vulnerabilities.

SIG-2026-0079.summary: Detects cross-user session_id manipulation on Open WebUI Socket.IO transports (>=0.9.0,<0.10.0) and Jupyter code-execution calls bypassing ENABLE_CODE_EXECUTION=false (<0.8.12).
SIG-2026-0079.title: Open WebUI Socket.IO get_event_call RCE & Jupyter Gate Bypass (CVE-2026-59216, CVE-2026-45672)

mitigation_steps: Isolate host or container immediately when web daemons spawn multiple recon/exploit binaries.
Enforce read-only root filesystems and seccomp/AppArmor child-process restrictions.

references.note: 10+ tool-spawn in 5m behavioral heuristic from ARTEX campaigns.

SIG-2026-0080.summary: Flags web or application server daemons spawning 10 or more distinct reconnaissance, cracking, or transfer utilities within a 5-minute burst window.
SIG-2026-0080.title: Web-Server Process Autonomous Recon & Exploit Tool-Spawn Burst

mitigation_steps: Correlate HTTP inter-arrival variance to flag zero-jitter 5-second C2 beacons.
Rate-limit and challenge automated headless browser pairs issuing simultaneous dual fetches.

references.note: Zero-jitter 5s CyberStrikeAI beacon and PentAGI dual-fetch telemetry.

SIG-2026-0081.summary: Detects CyberStrikeAI-style implants beaconing at exact 5-second zero-jitter intervals (12 hits/60s) or PentAGI browser agents requesting every target URL twice simultaneously.
SIG-2026-0081.title: Zero-Jitter 5-Second Agentic Beacon & Simultaneous Dual-Fetch Cadence

mitigation_steps: Revoke service principal credentials exhibiting sub-25-second secret-read-to-LLM validation bursts.
Alert on rapid /v1/models key sweeps followed by immediate proxy IP failover on 403/404.

references.note: Sub-25-second autonomous stolen-key verification and proxy-failover pattern.

SIG-2026-0082.summary: Detects sub-25-second autonomous cloud-to-LLM verification chains transitioning from Entra/ARM secret reads into /v1/models validation and proxy failover upon HTTP 403/404.
SIG-2026-0082.title: Self-Funding Stolen-Key Verification Sweep & Proxy-Failover Burst
